task.description: WF-03 Step 1: Root-cause diagnosis of ISS-0714 / GH #809. The dev/bench DB (BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev) fails default-tenant schema provisioning: provisionTenantSchema() returns error.MigrationFailed (tenant_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000), so public.tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at stays NULL and the ISS-0706 leg-(d) post-condition in src/tools/migrate.zig aborts `zig build migrate` / `zig build bench`. Diagnose the ROOT CAUSE: which migration in runForSchema fails on the dev DB, and why. Do NOT implement a fix in this step. Deliverable: root-cause analysis appended to docs/issues/ISS-0714.json (root_cause_analysis section) with the exact failing migration, the error, and the fix approach. The analysis must be specific enough for CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2) to write a fix design without re-diagnosing.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified: the specific migration file(s) that fail in runForSchema on the dev DB, and the SQL/error
Whether it's a state-mismatch (dev DB already partially provisioned) vs a migration-set defect
Whether repairing the dev DB alone suffices (re-run migrations) or the migration set needs a fix

result.summary: Root cause of ISS-0714/GH#809 diagnosed: STATE MISMATCH on the dev DB. tenant_default is already provisioned with the modern shape (events PARTITIONED BY RANGE(created_at) from 1147_par01) but its migration ledger (public.schema_migrations schema_name='tenant_default') is EMPTY and tenant_schemas.migrations_applied_at is NULL, so provisionTenantSchema() re-runs runForSchema('tenant_default') from scratch and 001_event_store.sql line 48 CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_event_idempotency ON events(idempotency_key) fails with SQLSTATE 42P16 (unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns; DETAIL: UNIQUE constraint on table "events" lacks column "created_at" which is part of the partition key). NOT a migration-set defect (test DB 5434 migrates 147/147 + 111 tenant_default with same partitioned events). Fix = repair dev DB only: populate tenant_default ledger (111 rows, ref = test DB) + stamp migrations_applied_at. Analysis written to docs/issues/ISS-0714.json (root_cause_analysis) and commented on GH #809.
result.root_cause: STATE MISMATCH (dev-DB-only). failing_migration=001_event_store.sql (line 48, uq_event_idempotency on events). sql_error=42P16 unique constraint on partitioned table must include all partitioning columns (DETAIL: lacks column created_at). state_mismatch_or_defect=STATE MISMATCH, not a migration-set defect (test DB proves set is good). repair_dev_db_only_or_migration_fix=repair_dev_db_only (ledger reconcile + stamp migrations_applied_at; no migration/code change).
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2) to design the dev-DB-only ledger-reconciliation + migrations_applied_at repair; then ISSUE-FIXER Step 2 implements it.
